estimates.name: Business Combinations — Description
estimates.t: Under this method, the identifiable tangible and intangible assets acquired and liabilities assumed are recognized based on their fair values as of the closing date of the transaction.

estimates.name: Judgments and uncertainties involved in the estimate
estimates.t: The acquisition method of accounting requires extensive use of estimates and judgments to allocate the consideration transferred to the identifiable tangible and intangible assets acquired, if any, and liabilities assumed.

estimates.name: Effect if actual results differ from assumptions
estimates.t: We base our fair value estimates on assumptions we believe are reasonable, but recognize the assumptions are inherently uncertain.

estimates.name: Goodwill — Description
estimates.t: Goodwill is the excess of the purchase price over the fair value of identifiable assets acquired, less fair value of liabilities assumed, in a business combination.

estimates.name: Judgments and uncertainties involved in the estimate
estimates.t: We make various estimates and assumptions about our goodwill, including whether any potential impairment events have occurred.

estimates.name: • A change in segment by one or more reporting unit
estimates.t: Additionally, we make estimates and assumptions regarding the inputs used to perform a quantitative assessment of our goodwill, if necessary, and the Company will perform a discounted cash flow analysis and a market multiple analysis.

estimates.name: Effect if actual results differ from assumptions
estimates.t: We have not made any material changes in our methodology used to determine whether potential impairment events have occurred or any material changes in the estimates and assumptions used in our quantitative goodwill impairment testing.
